caption:
🚨Pfizer knew vaccine doesn’t work to stop COVID with documents stating vaccine failure and failure of efficacy

Pfizer removed 8 COVID infected people that were vaccinated and died so they could falsely claim that you’re better off not being hospitalized and dying if you get vaccinated so they could get EUA.

Pfizer documents show that COVID-19 injections biodistribute in 48 hours and accumulates in liver, adrenals, spleen, lymphatic system, ovaries, and crosses the blood brain barrier. No method that the body gets rid of it. 

All in Pfizer’s internal trial data. They knew. No warnings, no recalls, still on the market. Not in the news, media coverage, just silence. FDA confidentiality. We only know now because Aaron Siri sued the FDA under Freedom of Information Act (FOIA) and Naomi Wolf’s team (DailyClout) that involved thousands of doctors and scientists reviewing 450,000 pages of released documents with findings now compiled in the book “The Pfizer Papers: Pfizer’s Crimes Against Humanity” 

Not advice, just Pfizer data and transparency. 

Thanks for learning with me!❤️
-Michaela 

#Pfizer #COVID #Corruption #InformedConsent #LearningTogether
